samples.label: The explicit danger variant wins over the legacy Info type.
Custom callouts retain serializable icon, color, class, and accessible-label props.
Accordion content from the production MDX compiler.
Protocol-relative links preserve external target semantics.
Wide media scrolls within this frame.
Layout adapters use the shared Tidal semantic tokens.
The explicit registry marks this view active after client mount.
Plain output inherits the compiled fence foreground.
"This source remains available in the compiled MDX tree."

Search requires supplied result data and an   callback, so the interactive
Search and SearchProvider examples live in the client fixture gallery.
ZoomControls and usePanZoom receive callbacks and therefore run in the separate client fixture.
The   block is verbatim from the executable Quickstart module. The two read lines are simplified illustrations of the same   and   calls.
